note: Counts describe taxonomy structure, not review prevalence. Definitions are unchanged.

topics.topic: Wait times and timeliness of care
topics.description: Speed from arrival through discharge or admission, including emergency, urgent and scheduled care.
Ability to obtain, change or cancel appointments and reach the facility for non-emergency care.
Physical access, mobility support, interpretation and sensory accommodations.

topics.topic: Front desk, reception and administrative staff conduct
topics.description: Courtesy, helpfulness and professionalism at registration and administrative contact.

topics.topic: Clinical staff bedside manner and empathy
topics.description: Respect, listening, compassion and professionalism from doctors, nurses and technicians.
Clinical updates, explanations, test results, callbacks and message consistency.

topics.topic: Nursing responsiveness and basic care needs
topics.description: Response to call buttons, assistance requests, toileting, positioning and comfort needs.
Charge accuracy, surprise bills, disputes, payment handling and collections.

topics.topic: Insurance coverage, denials and network issues
topics.description: Coverage checks, claim denials, authorization and out-of-network issues.
Visible sanitation, odors and tidiness in rooms, bathrooms and waiting areas.

topics.topic: Infection control and health safety practices
topics.description: Masks, entry testing, isolation protocols and protective equipment.
Meals, parking, wayfinding and comfort amenities.
Maintenance, noise, temperature and general physical comfort.

topics.topic: Visitor access, security and property safety
topics.description: Visitor policies, security interactions and personal-property safety.
Whether pain was taken seriously, treated promptly and controlled effectively.
Prescribing, administration, refills, pharmacy coordination and medication errors.
Evaluation thoroughness, diagnosis quality, testing decisions and physician involvement.
Preventable adverse events, procedural mistakes, neglect and safety lapses.
Ordering, scheduling, completion and results for labs, CT, MRI, X-ray and other tests.
Preparation, anesthesia, procedural quality, recovery and related communication.
Staffing, beds, equipment and the effects of overcrowding or under-resourcing.
Discharge timing, instructions, paperwork and immediate follow-up arrangements.
Continuity across providers, referrals, transfers, handoffs and follow-up care.
Accuracy, availability and access to records, charts and administrative paperwork.
Protection of health information and physical privacy during care.
Perceived bias or unfair treatment based on personal characteristics.
Quality, safety, environment and patient rights in mental-health and substance-use care.
Labor, delivery, NICU, pediatric emergency care and family-inclusive treatment.

topics.topic: Rehabilitation and long-term care / therapy services
topics.description: Physical, occupational and speech therapy plus rehabilitation and long-term care settings.
